entities.name: Tyrox
entities.description: Notorious Saurid immortal warrior from Muraganda who tried to seize power during the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: Saurid Autocracy
entities.description: Ruling faction of Muraganda that Tyrox belongs to.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Whose diplomats left Muraganda believing peace had been brokered.

events.summary: Tyrox sets up ambushes with his raiders along the race track to capture its technology and seize power, acting without the Autocracy's approval.
events.quote: Tyrox commanded his legions of raiders to set up ambushes in chokepoints along the track.

relations.note: Tyrox is an immortal of the Autocracy.
relations.quote: Tyrox is a notorious immortal of the Saurid Autocracy
